10 استجفاهُ He esteemed it (namely, a bed, &c., K) جَافٍ (S, K) i. e. thick, coarse, or rough. (TA.) ―
-b2- He demanded, or required, of him that he should do what was displeasing, grievous, vexatious, or evil. (TA.) ＝
-A2- استجفى He became coarse, rough, rude, unkind, hard, churlish, uncivil, or surly. (KL. [See also 1.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
